title: A digestive fluid is stored
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: The gallbladder stores and concentrates bile. It is the liver, not the gallbladder, that produces the bile.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which organ normally stores and concentrates bile made by the liver? The gallbladder stores and concentrates bile. It is the liver, not the gallbladder, that produces the bile.
The map shows selected connections schematically; it is not an anatomical scale drawing or a complete account of digestion.
